capacity_basis.selection: Resident points inside observed plateaus; paired footprints set full-cycle reuse distance. Intended levels are timing hypotheses, not verified per-access hit classes.
capacity_basis.spacing_note: 64 bytes is an access-layout parameter inherited from capacity, not a measured line size.
capacity_basis.memory_note: 256/512 MiB are observed large-footprint regions. Their first-pass timings need not be pure DRAM latency.
